environment.network: public endpoints only; no credentials, sessions, accounts, or signing of live material
environment.tools: curl, git, python3 (stdlib only for the reference implementation), node 24.22.1, xrpl-py 5.2.0

notes: Assessment + lab drills only: no live key material was used, no transactions sent, no flood traffic, no mainnet touched, nothing signed on the live network.
All drill keys are freshly generated LAB keys, wiped after the run; only public keys, fingerprints, addresses, and timings are recorded. Lab seeds are never written to disk.
Live values were re-probed for this pack; no numbers were copied from earlier packs.
The GitHub API was rate-limited during pin verification; the pin was verified from a local git checkout (rev-parse HEAD + log).
pack: PFTL address-format and wallet migration evidence pack
verdict: SOUND BUT FRAGILE AT THE EDGES — the address formats are correct and interoperable across three independent implementations, and the node rejects malformed input; every material risk sits at a boundary: curve choice, network identity, and client-side-only X-addresses.
